# Feature Spec — QR Code Generation

## Overview & Value

QR Code Generation — the slice the E-01 brief's §8 confirms.

## User Stories

US1 (P1) — As an Owner, I want to generate a QR code for a target URL, so that I can print it on the packaging.
Acceptance:
- [ ] The generated code resolves to the target the Owner supplied.

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| FR-001 | The system SHALL generate a scannable code for a supplied target URL. |
